headline: Sensex slumps 900 points as Brent crude tops $104 and RBI rate hike jitters weigh on Indian markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Brent crude oil prices surged above $104 per barrel, causing jitters on D-Street
The RBI's 25 basis points repo rate hike and hawkish tone impacted investor sentiment
Global headwinds are weighing on the market despite expectations of faster profit growth for Indian firms
Selling pressure intensified as the Nifty broke below the critical 22,300 support level
whatHappening: The Sensex slumped 900 points while the Nifty 50 dropped below the 22,300 mark
Paytm shares crashed 10%, resulting in a market capitalization loss of over Rs 10,970 crore
Life insurance companies reported a 21% jump in first-year premiums for the month of September
Cupid shares rallied 4%, continuing a massive multibagger trend with a 238% gain in 2026
summary: The Indian stock market faced a sharp selloff today with the Sensex plunging 900 points due to rising crude prices and the RBI's repo rate hike. While Paytm shares crashed significantly, multibagger stock Cupid and life insurer LIC bucked the trend with positive news. Investors remain cautious as Brent crude surpasses the $104 mark amid global economic headwinds.
